statements.statement: The PLOS ONE editors issued an Expression of Concern to inform readers of unresolved issues, and the authors did not respond or could not be reached.
The notice reports an apparent vertical discontinuity in the Fig. 4 LSD1 blot between 293T and A549 lanes; the paper uses Fig. 4 to show LSD1 is lower in A549 than H460.

The notice says Fig. 7 does not report data for an LSD1 siRNA experiment and the result that LSD1 siRNA reduced migrated H460 cells is not supported; the abstract reports siRNA or pargyline suppressed proliferation, migration and invasion.

The notice says controls in the Flag-LSD1 and LSD1 siRNA transfection experiments are not described in enough detail to replicate, and similarities with other groups' work call into question validity and provenance.
No impact assessment was completed for this alert; these fields are placeholders, not findings.
